incidents.name: Multiple Customers In India Were Incorrectly Charged Taxes During the January End of Month Cycle

incident_updates.body: Multiple customers in India were incorrectly charged taxes during the January end-of-month cycle. On January 28th, a tax ID revalidation caused many tax exemption flags to be incorrectly removed. Our team is actively investigating the root cause with our tax platform team. We expect to provide another update in 24 hours or as soon as more information becomes available.

scheduled_maintenances.name: Twilio Flex insights OpenSearch version upgrade - Maintenance

incident_updates.body:
This communication is related to a previous maintenance post which was communicated at https://status.twilio.com/incidents/mgtlpkppdw57? on February 6, 2026, 06:23 PST.  We’re creating a new post to correct the scheduled date for clarification. Please find the updated date hereunder:

We’re conducting a planned maintenance in US1 region between 9:30 PM and 12:00 AM Pacific Time on 02/19/2026. During the maintenance window, customers may experience the below issue:
-Increased rejections for incoming requests as the cluster load increases during blue/green deployments.
-Increased API latency on sync insights APIs.
-Possible loss of Taskrouter data on Sync Insights platform, that could lead to stale data on Teams View UI and API/SDK requests.
-Sync Insights APIs timeouts for API and Twilsock (SDK) requests.
